description.value: The Alpenglow Lodge is a vacation rental complex in Whistler Village managed by MountainView Accommodation, offering apartment-style stays steps from the village core. The property includes a hot tub and swimming pool (currently closed for renovation) and an elevator serving multiple floors. Its central Whistler location makes it a convenient base for cyclists exploring the Sea-to-Sky corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active vacation rental property managed by MountainView Accommodation at 4369 Main St, Whistler. The phone number on the website (1.604.905.4135) matches the OSM tag. A postal code discrepancy exists: OSM lists V0N 1B4 while the website footer shows V8E 1B7, and the website also adds unit number '107'; neither bike storage nor any cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site, so all such fields are null. The OSM internet_access=wlan tag cannot be confirmed from website content, so Wi-Fi is left null per the rules.
concerns: Postal code discrepancy: OSM has V0N 1B4 but website footer shows V8E 1B7. Website address used as more likely current.
Website shows unit number '107' prefixed to the address (107 4369 Main St) which is absent from the OSM record.

Property is operated under a management company brand (MountainView Accommodation) rather than as a standalone lodge; OSM name 'The Alpenglow Lodge' is consistent with the website but the managing entity name differs.
Hot tub and pool closed for renovations from April 6 2026 until further notice; elevator maintenance scheduled August–October 2026.
